findings.evidence: Current SQLite catalog stores ProviderToolSpec only; RuntimeServices has no Run exposure authority; checkpoint schema has no exposure; consumer composition cannot resolve durable catalog. Fresh schema-v5 is exact, so changing it needs explicit v5-to-v6 migration.
findings.root_cause: A second in-memory catalog was proposed instead of making SQLite UoW owner of one versioned RuntimeToolCatalogSnapshot envelope, StartSnapshot pin, versioned checkpoint exposure and exact handler resolver.

cross_cluster_refs.reason: Stored fields alone do not close activation transaction.
Exact MCP dispatch identity is required for rebind.

conclusion.summary: Define SQLite-owned catalog envelope, StartSnapshot pin, checkpoint exposure, RuntimeServices resolver, exact handler rebinding, explicit v5-to-v6 backup-first migration and legacy-static mode; spike migration and restart with missing/changed handler fail-closed.
